scope: Engine controls plus exact active source pair-call parity; never complete physical geometry or CCD qualification

pqp_controls.same_pose: same actual original PQP mesh, identity rotations, both zero translations; query_code=0 and CloserThanTolerance=1
pqp_controls.far_pose: same mesh, translation x=2*AABB_diagonal+8+1 millimeters; query_code=0 and CloserThanTolerance=0

planar_source_function_controls.self_positive: q=[0,pi/2,-pi,0,...] first and third nonadjacent segments intersect at (1,0); source self_collision must be false; this is a function control, no joint-limit claim
planar_source_function_controls.self_negative: all q=0 gives separated nonadjacent collinear segments; source self_collision must be true
planar_source_function_controls.obstacle_positive: q0=atan2(2,8), remaining q=0; eighth vertex within original circle center(8,2) and inflated radius(0.8+0.3); source obstacle_collision=false
planar_source_function_controls.obstacle_negative: q0=-pi/2, remaining q=0; downward vertices clear all original circles plus original f=0.3 margin; source obstacle_collision=true

pair_audit: Strip comments only, compare complete active PQP_Tolerance argument strings in source with instrumented p4_query arguments for native/aligned; require exact parity, preserve original omissions
source_policy_status_requires: all fixed controls pass and all active source-pair arguments match
raw_query_status: CHECKED; means one real source-policy query with source TCP/independent FK agreement; does not itself mean engine controls passed
qualified_status: SOURCE_POLICY_QUALIFIED; only after this fixed control result is bound by hash in the calling qualification protocol
non_goals: No endpoint, IK, NR, RSS, RBS or planning calls
No mesh, pair, tolerance or source policy change
No solid-volume interpretation of source ABB collinear rod triangles
